verdict.rationale: Obsidian documents a clear community plugins system for extending functionality (obsidian-docs-7, obsidian-docs-31, obsidian-docs-33), with plugin access available on desktop and mobile (obsidian-docs-34), and community evidence discusses real plugins (Dataview, Text-Generator, Git, custom collaboration plugins) confirming an active, large ecosystem in practice (obsidian-comm-5, obsidian-comm-6, obsidian-comm-7, obsidian-comm-8). Missing for 10: no explicit evidence of catalog size/browsing UI details or in-app discovery/install flow specifics beyond restricted-mode security notes.
